definitions.supplemental: geofon a sea, ocean; flód a flood

quotations.old_english: Dryhtnes bibod geofonflóda gehwylc georne bihealdeþ
quotations.english: each ocean flood strictly observes the Lord's command

source_text: geofon-flód, es; m. [geofon a sea, ocean; flód a flood] A sea or ocean flood; maris fluctus :-- Dryhtnes bibod geofonflóda gehwylc georne bihealdeþ each ocean flood strictly observes the Lord's command, Exon. 54 b; Th. 193, 21; Az. 125.
